_comment: The PERCENTAGE reflect (PO ruling 2026-08-17), and the deliberate superior tier over FireShield's flat one: a cooldown you spend to turn the next ten seconds of incoming punishment into outgoing damage. Structurally it is a lifesteal_burst read from the hit side rather than a second FireShield — activation puts a timed SELF-buff up (new `retaliate_burst` effect type), and the buff is what the hit site reads, so it composes with whatever loadout is on instead of belonging to one aura. That is also why the two reflects stack cleanly: a player running FireShield and Retribution deals TWO separate attributed hits per incoming swing, each with its own damage type, never one summed hit. THREE PO RULINGS are baked in. (1) The share is of the PRE-MITIGATION hit, the swing as the mob authored it: it keeps the mitigated-hit-still-retaliates convention the passive already had, and it stops a tanky build from weakening its own reflect by being hard to hurt (a fully shielded hit reflects exactly as much as one that lands). (2) The reflected damage carries the tags authored HERE, never mirrored from whatever hit you, the FireShield convention: the attacker's own resistances answer a damage type this skill chose, so a fire-immune mob shrugs Retribution off and that is the counterplay. (3) Level scales the SHARE only; the window is flat, the Bloodthirst rule, because the PO specified the window and level should buy strength rather than uptime. It reaches whoever hit you through the same attributed path FireShield uses, so a reflect-only kill pays XP and kill credit like any other. ⚑ Raw damage, same as the flat reflect: no crit, no lifesteal, no DamageDealtBonus. Unlike FireShield's flat amount this one scales with the fight instead of the character, which is exactly why it is the higher tier and why it does NOT inherit FireShield's open does-this-scale question. ⚑ No pip: applied_effects is a full ubyte (the Bloodthirst problem), and a reflect is worse off than a leech there because its numbers float off the ATTACKER where they are hard to tell from any other damage — the cooldown icon's own timer is the honest tell until backlog §39 widens the byte. All values [PLACEHOLDER]: 20% at L1 rising to 40% at L5, 300 ticks = 10 s at 30 tps, cooldown 900 −60/L and cost 0.02 +0.0025/L mirroring Bloodthirst, the other 'spend now to survive the next few seconds' cooldown of the same shape. Obtainable in dev via the SKILL Retribution cheat; no unlock source yet (the FireShield precedent), real placement comes with the content pass.
